## What I tried and what killed things

**Ashby is not uniformly blind.** Worth correcting the standing assumption: `jobs.ashbyhq.com` returned "You need to enable JavaScript" for n8n's board index, Supabase, Pyyne and Dash0 — but the n8n FDE-EMEA posting and the Vapi posting both served real body copy. When an Ashby posting matters, it's worth one fetch before writing it off.

**Roles that looked alive on search but were dead on the real ATS** (exactly the failure mode you flagged):
- **Airtable "Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA"** — job ID redirects to a board with 17 roles, zero EMEA. Dead.
- **Keyrus Portugal "Power Platform & Copilot Studio Developer (AI Agent)"** — HTTP 410. Dead, despite ranking well on Remotive and Himalayas.
- **Convera "Power Platform Engineer (Automation & Copilot Development)"** — job ID redirects to the 59-role board. Dead. It kept resurfacing across five separate searches.
- **Workato "Technical Consultant II (EMEA Market)"** — Greenhouse job ID 302-redirects to workato.com/careers. Dead; only alive on VC job boards.
- **ClickHouse "Solutions Architect - LangFuse EMEA"** — redirects to board. Dead.
- **Adomik, dentolo/getolo, Ludicrum Tech** — 410 / "position no longer active".
- **Every Built In listing I checked** (n8n Workflow Automation Engineer, Sartorius Copilot Studio Madrid, Integry, Conductor) carried an explicit "this job was removed" stamp — Built In is fine for discovering company+title, useless as evidence of liveness.

**Hard-gate kills:**
- *Language:* adesso NL (Dutch), HSO Group (sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse), Blümlein (German), epilot (German, and they even ask your German level as a form question), Hygraph Berlin (business-level German), Sulava Helsinki (Finnish), Avanade Vienna (German posting), Reply Polska (Polish), Webflow SE EMEA (German fluency), plus most of Postman's EMEA bench which is French/German/Spanish-speaking CSE roles.
- *Seniority:* Codec, Capgemini Polska, Parloa, Fireworks, GitLab ("Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC"), Retool's entire EMEA bench (Principal Solutions Architect / Senior Sales Engineer), Keyrus AI Engineer (5+) and Keyrus FDE (5–10).
- *Wrong geography:* Tray.io Sales Engineer (Bay Area — annoying, since he holds their certs), Tavily FDE (NYC), Aircall FDE (NYC), Talkdesk (US remote), Celonis Partner SE (NYC), NICE (Hoboken — and it names Claude Code, n8n and Power Automate, a perfect stack match in the wrong country), Bold Business n8n role (India/Philippines), Satellite Office (Manila), David Kennedy (Bangkok), Avanade R00318238 (Melbourne, despite an India URL).
- *Body shops / talent pools:* Hays Poland, emagine, Axiom Software Solutions, Huzzle, Nortal/Nearsure "Talent Connection", Xebia "ECT - Contractors Talent Pool".
- *Already applied, hit and skipped:* Spyrosoft, HICX, Camunda, Atrix, Arize, Ophelos, Atmen, A-Players.

**Dry wells worth not re-running:** Zapier has no findable European board or EMEA opening. Contentful's Europe roles are all engineering-management and ML in London/Dublin. Xebia CEE's 50 roles contain zero Power Platform. Tray.io's only Greenhouse posting is US. Airtable, Temporal and DataDome boards are US/France-only. Make.com does not surface a separate Prague board — everything runs through Celonis Greenhouse, which is US-weighted.

**Category B structural note:** the European Power Platform market splits cleanly into German/Dutch/Finnish-language partner consultancies (hard-gated) and Polish/Czech B2B contract shops (open, English-speaking, and where all four of his Category B survivors came from). Poland is the highest-yield country for this slice by a wide margin.

## What killed things

**Category A is effectively dead right now — this is the headline finding.** I checked every name on your list and the sector simply is not hiring engineers in Europe:
- **OfficeRnD** — careers page says "we're currently hiring for various engineering, sales, marketing and customer services positions" but renders **zero actual listings**; their jobs.bg company page returns **403**. No verifiable opening.
- **Nexudus** — careers page has no listings at all.
- **Cobot** — Workable board renders nothing and no individual job URLs are indexed. **Coworks**, **Workero**, **Workbox**, **Occuspace** — same, Workable shells.

- **Casavo** — "No jobs found" across all eight departments.
- **Kadence** — 6 openings, all Salt Lake City / San Jose / Belfast, zero EU engineering.
- **deskbird** — 6 openings, all sales/marketing/finance, zero engineering.
